architectural_notes: Add input validation for MGP licence format: must start with literal 'Mgp-' then allow alphanumeric characters (letters/numbers) after the dash.

existing_features.title: Update the MGP validation logic so the accepted format is exactly the prefix "Mgp-" (capital M, then gp, then hyphen) followed by one or more letters and/or numbers (A–Z, a–z, 0–9).
Update the Gen 4 (ELC options) Mgp entry UI to refer to "Mgp licence" and show the required format using the exact prefix "Mgp-" in user-facing text (title/description/label/placeholder/error).
Update the Gen 5 options Mgp entry UI to refer to "Mgp licence" and show the required format using the exact prefix "Mgp-" in user-facing text (title/description/label/placeholder/error).

new_feature_requests.summary: For both Gen 4 and Gen 5, require the 'Enter MGP licence' field to match the exact prefix 'Mgp-' (capital M) followed by any letters/numbers

projectName: Update Gen 4 & Gen 5 Mgp licence format to require 'Mgp-' prefix + alphanumeric
